sermon.title: Making Room—December 8, 2024
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: There was no room for Jesus in the inn. We are His temple—will we make room by giving time and lowering pride? The Shunammite built a room for Elisha; a swept but empty house invites worse. Jesus knocks; let Him in to clean house and heal.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to the city of David, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and lineage of David, to be registered with Mary, his betrothed wife, who was with child. So it was, that while they were there, the days were completed for her to be delivered. And she brought forth her firstborn Son, and wrapped Him in swaddling cloths, and laid Him in a manger, because there was no room for them in the inn.
Do you not know that you are the temple of God and that the Spirit of God dwells in you?
